note: Spoken text only. Stage directions from the approved script are stripped; the pauses they call for are cut in as silence at the timings below, not spoken and not left to the TTS to invent. Text is verbatim — do not edit to fit timing.

voice.voice_id: PENDING — user picks by ear from the shortlist, then this is locked as the Little Hive house voice for every future reel

lines.text: Have you noticed your two-month-old looking right at you?
lines.direction: Genuine question. Lift on 'noticed' resolves down, not up.

lines.text: Two months is when they start looking back.
lines.direction: Flat and certain. Do not push it.

lines.text: Faces become the most interesting thing in the room.

lines.direction: Warmth on 'favourite' — the smile behind it, not volume.

lines.text: Smile at them, talk to them — some babies will smile back.
lines.direction: Slows, per the script. ~125 wpm. The dash is a real half-beat pause.

lines.text: Listen for sounds that aren't crying. A grumble. A small vowel.
lines.direction: Practical, a touch brisker. Air between the two short sentences.

lines.text: Make the sound back, then wait. Often, they go again.
lines.direction: TAKES THE SMILE, on 'Often, they go again'. Hold the comma.

lines.text: Some do this at six weeks. Some nearer three months. Both are ordinary.
lines.direction: Even, unhurried. State it as fact — added warmth reads as consolation.
Slow and quieter, ~6dB down, almost to herself.

lines.text: Save this for the week it happens.
lines.direction: Lighter, an aside. Same voice, less projection. No upsell lift.
